# Anish Sahoo

> Backend/AI/ML engineer based in Boston, MA. I build AI infrastructure at Cloudflare, contributing to Workers AI and replicate/cog. Outside work, I shoot Sony and listen to music.

Personal site: https://asahoo.dev. The site is intentionally minimal and loads in one round trip.

## Pages

- [Home](https://asahoo.dev/): Bio, recent notes, current activity, and a photo preview.
- [Notes](https://asahoo.dev/notes/): Writing on software, AI/ML, and photography.
- [Projects](https://asahoo.dev/projects/): Side projects, open-source work, and hackathon projects.
- [Photos](https://asahoo.dev/photos/): Street and travel photography.
- [Now](https://asahoo.dev/now/): Current work, gear, and side projects.
- [Resume](https://asahoo.dev/resume.pdf): PDF resume.

## Notes

- [Goodbye, Fujifilm](https://asahoo.dev/notes/goodbye-fujifilm/): Why I switched camera systems.
- [Spring AI is better than you'd think](https://asahoo.dev/notes/spring-ai-is-nice/): Thoughts on a welcome addition to the Spring ecosystem.

## Selected Projects

- [leap](https://github.com/anish-sahoo/leap): Fast, native macOS window switcher.
- [cog](https://github.com/replicate/cog): Improved packaging for ML models.
- [toggo](https://github.com/generatenu/toggo): Turn group-chat trip plans into real plans.
- [image-storage-api](https://github.com/anish-sahoo/image-storage-api): Small-scale file hosting for site assets.
- [ResumeTex](https://resumetex.asahoo.dev): Converts JSON resumes into LaTeX/PDF using Jake's Resume format.
